remarks: Welcome to this charming and sun-filled 1-bedroom unit in the highly sought-after Rowayton Woods Complex. Entire Unit was freshly painted, brand-new hardwood flooring were just installed, the bathroom was also recently renovated, this 3rd-floor home offers comfort and style. Enjoy serene pond views from your private covered balcony - the perfect spot to relax and unwind.  Ideally located, you're just minutes from Metro-North, shopping, dining, the beach, and major highways. Rowayton Woods offers fantastic amenities including a swimming pool, tennis courts, a community garden, and scenic walking trails, all surrounded by tranquil pond views.  Don't miss this opportunity to live in one of the most sought-after desirable communities!
